# SMAA

SMAA 2.8 by Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro and Diego Gutierrez.

Source: https://github.com/iryoku/smaa (retrieved 2026-11-12).
The upstream `SMAA.hlsl`, `Textures/AreaTex.h` and `Textures/SearchTex.h` are kept unchanged.
FENB uses the spatial 1x High preset with color edge detection; it does not implement temporal SMAA.
See `LICENSE.txt` for the upstream license.
